([[Marietta, Georgia]]) | college = * [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State]] (2022–2025) * [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida]] (2025–2026) | highlights = * [[American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|American Conference Player of the Year]] (2026) * First-team All-[[American Athletic Conference|American Conference]] (2026) * Third-team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]] (2025) }} '''Izaiyah Nelson''' (born October 1, 2003) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida Bulls]] of the [[American Conference (NCAA)|American Conference]]. He previously played for the [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State Red Wolves]]. == High school career == Nelson attended [[Marietta High School (Georgia)|Marietta High School]]. He played football before becoming more serious about basketball as a sophomore in high school.{{cite web |last1=Ruiz |first1=Savannah |title=Inside the game of USF men’s basketball standout Izaiyah Nelson |url=https://www.usf.edu/news/2026/inside-the-game-of-usf-mens-basketball-standout-izaiyah-nelson.aspx |website=[[South Florida Bulls]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=February 9, 2026}} Nelson averaged 8.6 points, 8.2 rebounds, 1.1 steals, and 1.0 blocks per game as a senior.{{cite web |last1=Hines |first1=Jamaill |title=A Scout’s Take: Izaiyah Nelson Demands Your Attention |url=https://www.noceilingsnba.com/p/a-scouts-take-izaiyah-nelson-demands |website=No Ceilings |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=January 16, 2026}} He committed to play college basketball at [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State]].{{cite web |last1=Johnston |first1=Joey |title=Always On: Izaiyah Nelson’s Relentless Energy Is Fueling USF Men’s Basketball |url=https://gousfbulls.com/news/2026/1/13/mens-basketball-always-on-isaiyah-nelsons-relentless-energy-is-fueling-usf-mens-basketball.aspx |website=[[South Florida Bulls]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=January 13, 2026}} == College career == Nelson played three years at [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State]] under coach [[Bryan Hodgson]]. He averaged 9.8 points and 7.6 rebounds per game as a sophomore.{{cite web |title=Izaiyah Nelson Earns Ro CBI All-Tournament Nod |url=https://astateredwolves.com/news/2024/3/27/mens-basketball-izaiyah-nelson-earns-ro-cbi-all-tournament-nod.aspx |website=[[Arkansas State Red Wolves]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=March 27, 2024}} As a junior, he averaged 10.6 points, 8.9 rebounds, 0.7 steals, and 1.3 blocks per game and was named to the Third Team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]]. Following the season, he followed coach Hodgson to [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida]]. As a senior, Nelson was named the [[American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|American Conference Player of the Year]], defensive player of the year and newcomer of the year. He averaged 15.8 points and 9.8 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last1=Skol |first1=Mark |title=USF star Izaiyah Nelson more proud of team success than historic conference honors |url=https://www.fox13news.com/sports/usf-star-izaiyah-nelson-more-proud-team-success-than-historic-conference-honors |access-date=April 5, 2026 |work=Fox 13 News |date=March 13, 2026}} == References == {{reflist}} == External links == * [https://astateredwolves.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/izaiyah-nelson/7128 Arkansas State Red Wolves bio] * [https://gousfbulls.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/izaiyah-nelson/15678 South Florida Bulls bio] {{American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Nelson, Izaiyah}} [[Category:2003 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Marietta, Georgia]] [[Category:South Florida Bulls men's basketball players]]
